title: Learning with Active Quantum Subspaces: Scalable Hybrid Advantage without Full Quantum Data-Encoding
summary: We study whether quantum learning advantage can persist without fully embedding a large classical input into a highly superposed quantum state. To address this question, we introduce active quantum subspace data-encoding, in which only an information-bearing subset of the input is lifted to a quantum representation while the remaining variables stay classical. For this model, we define a projected hybrid readout and prove three structural results.
